description: Formal style contract between @wabou/vite and the native projection. Every compiler-emitted property maps losslessly to the Wabou renderer or explicit node metadata; everything else is a compile error.

unsupported.box-sizing: Wabou owns box layout and does not expose a selectable CSS box model.
unsupported.contain: Wabou does not expose CSS containment as a style property.
unsupported.flex: Use the explicit flex-grow, flex-shrink and flex-basis fields projected by Wabou.
unsupported.grid-auto-flow: The Wabou grid subset requires explicit templates and placements.
unsupported.grid-template-areas: Wabou does not expose named grid areas.
unsupported.justify-items: The Wabou style contract does not expose justify-items.
unsupported.justify-self: The Wabou style contract does not expose justify-self.
unsupported.border-style: Only solid borders are implemented; style keywords have no host mapping.
unsupported.text-decoration: Text decoration painting is not implemented.
unsupported.outline: The Wabou style contract does not expose production outlines; use borders or a dedicated focus-ring component.
unsupported.outline-color: The Wabou style contract does not expose production outlines.
unsupported.outline-offset: The Wabou style contract does not expose production outlines.
unsupported.outline-style: The Wabou style contract does not expose production outlines.
unsupported.outline-width: The Wabou style contract does not expose production outlines.
unsupported.list-style-type: List marker painting is not implemented.
unsupported.transition: CSS is stateless; drive runtime transform state from JS or Rust.
unsupported.animation: CSS is stateless; drive runtime transform state from JS or Rust.

unsupportedPrefixes.transition-: CSS is stateless; drive runtime transform state from JS or Rust.
unsupportedPrefixes.animation-: CSS is stateless; drive runtime transform state from JS or Rust.
